name: ad-creative
description: Character counts and numbered platform rules for ad text, then a statistical read of creative results. Counts every field against dated Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok limits using each platform's counting rule; lists each problem with its rule id, source and read date; keeps a claim ledger so no figure appears without the user's proof; reads ad results with a declared primary metric, intervals and the impressions still needed; and builds search and social variant sets and evidence-traced angles that pass the same checks. Works only on text and numbers you paste; makes no images or video and changes nothing in any ad account.
